text:
Alex K: quick handover before I sign off in 8m. Primary for next 12h is Maria L, backup is Tim O. Note: APAC overnight coverage gap between 02:00-05:00 UTC — no dedicated APAC secondary. If pages hit then, escalate to Jess R / Ravi P.

Alex K: access checklist (please verify)
- PagerDuty: can you trigger/ack/resolve and run the `prod-critical-escalation` play
- AWS: assume-role `redwood-oncall` in acct 123456789012 for runbook ops
- Grafana: view prod dashboards + ability to add annotations (edit/annotate useful)
- Runbooks: https://runbooks.redwood.com/watchstand-handoff

oncall-bot: bridge opened: https://meet.redwood.com/bridge/handoff-2109876543 — all auto-logs will post to the bridge channel. Use for any live mitigation.

Maria L: ack. I have PD access and can trigger escalation. I do NOT have Grafana annotate/edit rights yet — can someone grant temporary annotate for my session? :raising_hand:

Tim O: I see the APAC gap. I can extend coverage until 03:30 UTC if needed. I also need Grafana annotate rights to leave short triage notes.

Jess R: I can grant Grafana annotate/edit for the watchstand role for 12h. Applying temporary grant now; will post revoke command.

Jess R: granted. Grafana role `watchstand-annotator` added for Maria L and Tim O. You should get an invite email; enable the "Edit annotations" toggle on prod/latency and prod/errors panels. :white_check_mark:

Ravi P: AWS assume-role details:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-oncall --role-session-name watchstand-<yourname>
```
Make sure MFA is configured. This role provides CloudWatch LogRead + access to runbook playbooks only (no admin console perms). For broader perms open an infra ticket.

Tim O: thanks Ravi. Which CloudWatch log groups should I tail for latency/errors?

Ravi P: tail these groups: `/aws/redwood/prod/latency` and `/aws/redwood/prod/errors`.
Quick tail command:
```
aws logs tail /aws/redwood/prod/latency --follow --profile watchstand
```

Maria L: PD flow reminder — on a SEV1, ack it, call primary oncall number, then trigger `prod-critical-escalation` if not acked within 2m. PD schedule: https://pd.redwood.com/schedules/watchstand

Alex K: runbook highlights: start at `watchstand-triage` -> check infra-health -> validate model-serving latency -> check cache hit rates -> if fallback to smaller model was auto-used, follow `model-fallback-procedure`. Please leave a Grafana annotation with short summary + actions taken.

Jess R: I've also created a temporary PagerDuty role mapping so Maria & Tim can trigger escalation. It will expire in 12h. If it doesn't, ping me and I'll revoke.

Tim O: confirmed Grafana + PD. One request: can someone add a small list of non-prod test prompts that emulate high token usage so we can validate mitigations without hitting prod?

Alex K: adding test prompts to the runbook under `diagnostics/test-prompts` — use only against staging models, do NOT run them against prod endpoints.

oncall-bot: action required — please reply with `checked` once you validate: PagerDuty access, Grafana annotate, AWS assume-role, runbook link.

Maria L: checked. Verified PD ack/trigger, Grafana annotate present, AWS assume-role succeeded and I can tail logs. Will add first shift notes after a dashboard walk.

Tim O: checked. I can cover until 03:30 UTC for APAC, Grafana annotate working, AWS role OK. Leaving phone in DM for urgent callouts.

Jess R: noted. I'll monitor the temporary grants and revoke after 12h. Posting revoke command here in case someone needs it sooner:
```
# revoke watchstand grafana role
rgw-admin revoke-role --role watchstand-annotator --users MariaL,TimO
# revoke pd mapping
pd-admin mappings delete --alias watchstand-temp-esc
```

Ravi P: confirming CloudWatch metric dashboards have a 1m refresh and alert thresholds are set to 99th pct latency > 1200ms. If those trip, PD will send a SEV2 by default, SEV1 if accompanied by error-rate spike.

Alex K: thanks team. I'm off now. If a page comes in, follow the above flow and drag me into the bridge if context needed. :wave:
